# Golden output of src/ui/theme/Sizing.qml, captured from the QML implementation
# before any of it moved to Rust (see docs/qt-to-rust-extraction.md, Stage 1).
# One flat key=value line per config case. The six inputs are screen_width,
# screen_height, crt, bitmap, swap and profile, measured as Sizing itself sees
# them: after the CRT 5% safe-area inset and after any rotation swap. Everything
# after those six is a derived value zaparoo_app::sizing must reproduce exactly.
#
# Regenerate: see the dump procedure in docs/qt-to-rust-extraction.md.
